items.note: 600 students from 10 universities split into a control group and a group that used ChatGPT for creative-writing essays scored on originality, presentation, accuracy, and elaboration; assignment method not stated and the analysis uses a Wilcoxon signed-rank test, so check the design in the full text.

Preregistered online experiment randomly exposing half of 453 professionals to ChatGPT on incentivized writing tasks with graded output quality; creativity enters only through an originality sub-grade reported in the working-paper versions (SSRN 10.2139/ssrn.4375283 is the same study).

RCT assigning musically trained people to compose a 15-second piano melody with an AI-ideation tool or no AI, with external listeners rating creativity; abstract gives no N (search notes cite 140 from a CMU news release).

Quasi-experiment with 41 fourth-graders in Turkey (convenience-sampled groups) doing five weeks of creative writing with ChatGPT versus paper and pencil, with creative writing skills scored from students' texts; below 50 participants and not randomized.

Two-group pretest-posttest study of 64 undergraduates making digital stories on generative AI platforms versus conventional platforms; outcomes are narrative intelligence, writing self-efficacy, and creative identity, and it is unclear whether narrative intelligence is scored on the stories or is a self-report scale.

Exploratory comparison of a historical control cohort (N=12) and an intervention cohort (N=16) in a knit yarn design course where GenAI ideation is bundled with flipped learning; creativity-thinking scores are reported but it is unclear whether they are scored on design output.

Three yearly cohorts of master's retail design students did the same exercise with Midjourney introduced at different phases or not at all, and designs were assessed for creativity, innovativeness, and originality; non-random cohort comparison, N not stated.

Three experiments in which 2,939 writers (total, largest single experiment not stated) wrote political opinion paragraphs with and without AI assistance, rated by 11,091 blind readers on 29 dimensions including writing quality; the task is opinion writing rather than a creative task and the main outcome is perceived persona, so eligibility under criterion 3 is doubtful.

Single-group pre-post study of 36 Indonesian grade 11 EFL students writing folklore narratives before and after a six-week Sudowrite intervention, scored on a rubric (structure, idea development, characterization, language, mechanics); no control group and AI access at posttest is not stated (abstract from the journal landing page).

Within-person design: 110 biology undergraduates listed innovative energy sources alone and, four weeks later, with ChatGPT-3, scored on Guilford fluency, flexibility, elaboration, and originality; fixed order, so condition is confounded with time.
